description: Drug interactions come only from FDA drug labels and supplement-supplement ones only from Aviado's verified pairs; an empty result is not evidence that there is no interaction. Labels are thorough for some supplements and sparse or missing for most; read coverage.drug, and never treat an empty or short list as proof of safety. To check one medication pass drug (generic name; salt forms merged, so 'warfarin' matches 'warfarin sodium'; brand names are not matched). Also returns supplement-supplement interactions from Aviado's verified pairs only (synergies, antagonisms, absorption conflicts, timing), except on a drug check unless include_supplement_interactions is true. Interactions recorded for what the supplement contains are included and labelled: fish oil returns EPA, DHA and omega-3 interactions (interaction_sources, recorded_for). Drug entries are one per drug, most severe first, paged with drug_limit/drug_offset (drug_page.total, next_offset); label_artifact_suspected marks an entry whose drug name contains the supplement only as a salt (e.g. esomeprazole magnesium) and whose text does not mention it. Data-source failures return an error, never an empty list. The supplement may be a name or an Aviado canonical_id (from search_supplements or a candidates list). Check status first: needs_confirmation / no_match means the input did not resolve, data is null and next_step says how to retry.

drug.description: Only return drug interactions for this drug: its generic name (e.g. 'warfarin', 'sertraline'), matched exactly with salt forms merged ('warfarin' matches 'warfarin sodium'); brand names are not matched. Supplement-supplement interactions are then omitted unless include_supplement_interactions is true

drug_limit.description: Max drug interactions to return (default 20, max 200)

drug_offset.description: Drug interactions to skip, for paging (use drug_page.next_offset)

include_supplement_interactions.description: Include supplement-supplement interactions (default: true without drug, false when drug is given)

name: get_supplement_interactions
title: Supplement interactions (drugs and supplements)
